messages.content: amar roommate er sathe thik jachhe na, ekdom alada lifestyle
Kon jaigatay sobcheye beshi clash hocche - cleanliness, noise, naki guest niye asha?
Eta khub practical issue, emotional na hole solve kora shohoj - specific rules set kora jai jemon kon somoy porjonto quiet thakte hobe. Kotha bolecho ei niye directly?
na, bhoy lagche awkward hoye jabe bole
Awkward hoyeo hoy, kintu chup kore thakle resentment barbe just. Ekta neutral somoy e, calmly bola best - blame na kore, just "amader ekta schedule thik kora dorkar" emon bhabe shuru kora jete pare.
